title: Awesome app but with some problems
body: Starting off, Fabulous is a great and amazing app. I love Fabulous’ goal to help people, its awesome advice and features too. I just wish I could interact with the developers or people in charge to ask about certain things instead of just reviews or little notes. This isn’t a problem but, I also don’t like the quiz for your own custom morning routine and as soon as you finish the quiz it says that the routine is locked and that you need premium. Pretty dissapointing especially with the fact there wasn’t a notice letting you know that you need premium before doing the quiz. 😕💙🪷
